description: Read one of your support threads with every turn: your questions (role user), Rupert's answers (assistant) and the support team's follow-ups (admin, with author_name). Opening it marks it read for you, which clears it from threads_with_unread_admin_reply. Continue the thread with ask_support(conversation_id=...). Not found unless the thread is yours (a system admin reads any thread). Guide: enricher://docs/support

conversation_id.description: The thread's id, as ask_support returned it.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
